note: Static manifest. A job type is listed only if a real headless handler exists today. Everything else is unsupported and must fail closed with `unsupported`. SONG_RESOLUTION (per-song) has no headless handler; the corpus-level resolver is exposed as RESOLVER_CALIBRATION, not as SONG_RESOLUTION. `verification` records WHERE each entry has actually been executed; a Runner must still earn the capability on its own machine (start-up preflight) before advertising it.

constraints: private corpus audio must not be uploaded or committed

verification.detail: synthetic corpus: launch/exit/report/validation plumbing verified on the user's Mac; resolver quality is NOT_MEASURED. See docs/artist-os/mac-proof.md.

runnable.entry: tools/build-render-cli.sh (builds take-layer-render from the same Swift sources as the iOS app)
runnable.input: RenderEditPlanRequest JSON (schemaVersion 1): ShortEditDraft fields + timeline + local source paths resolved on the Mac
output: <output>.mp4.commit.json (written after the atomic rename; the only proof of completion)
constraints: TimelineMapper is the only sync authority (no reimplementation)
Short profile only: 1080x1920, 30 fps, H.264 MP4
master WAV is the only program audio

verification.detail: RENDER_EDIT_PLAN stays NOT_VERIFIED until a real performance video + its completed WAV pass the real-media gate (same take, completed-WAV audio, human-confirmed sync, real-person crop). Timed cues are renderer timed text, not lyric alignment. See docs/artist-os/mac-proof.md and Artist-OS docs/audit/TAKE_LAYER_MAC_PROOF.md.
